Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) now offers server group restart feature in public preview

Body.Content:
When you use the server group restart feature, all nodes in your Hyperscale (Citus) server group are restarted. You will be given advanced notification of any database downtime that the server group restart will cause. The Hyperscale (Citus) server group restart capability is currently available in the Azure portal. Please note this feature is available in the East US region only.

Learn more.
